license_required.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice certified public accountancy in the State

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Public Accountancy

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Public Accountancy

type.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Public Accountancy

age_minimum.quote: The applicant shall be at least 18 years old

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good character and reputation

degree_required.value: baccalaureate or higher degree with major in accounting or substantial equivalent
degree_required.quote: an applicant shall have satisfactorily completed 150 semester hours or their equivalent, including the attainment of a baccalaureate or higher degree that meets the requirements of this section

accrediting_body.value: Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business, Accreditation Council for Business Schools and Programs, or regional accrediting associations
accrediting_body.quote: The degree required under this section shall be awarded by a school, college, university, or other institution that: (1) is a member of the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business; (2) is a member of the Accreditation Council for Business Schools and Programs; (3) is accredited by or is a constituent unit of an institution accredited by: (i) the Middle States Association of Colleges and Schools; or (ii) the equivalent regional accrediting association for other regional areas; or (4) is recognized and approved by the Board

required.quote: The applicant for an initial license shall complete practical work experience that is approved by the Board

duration.value: 1-3 years with minimum 2,000 hours if applicant applies on or after October 1, 2000
duration.quote: is obtained over a period of: (i) not more than 3 years; and (ii) 1. not less than 6 months if the applicant applies before October 1, 2000; or 2. not less than 1 year if the applicant applies on or after October 1, 2000

kind.value: practical work experience in accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting services
kind.quote: includes providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.quote: The Board shall give the examination prepared by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or an equivalent examination as determined by the Board

interval_years.quote: the license expires on the first December 31 that comes: (1) after the effective date of the license; and (2) in an even–numbered year

required.quote: A continuing education requirement does not apply to the first renewal of a license

hours_per_period.quote: To qualify for any further renewal of a license under this subtitle, a licensee shall complete, for each 2–year license term, at least 80 hours in programs that the Board approves

period_years.quote: for each 2–year license term, at least 80 hours in programs that the Board approves

available.quote: the Board may waive any examination requirement of this subtitle for: (1) a certified public accountant licensed by another state

requirements.value: Applicant must be of good character, at least 18 years old, pay application and license fees, and provide evidence of substantially equivalent education, examination, and experience requirements or 4 years of practical work experience within last 10 years after passing Uniform CPA Examination
requirements.quote: The Board may grant a waiver under this section only if the applicant: (1) is of good character and reputation; (2) is at least 18 years of age; (3) pays to the Board: (i) a nonrefundable application fee set by the Board; and (ii) a license fee set by the Board; and (4) provides adequate evidence that the applicant has met educational, examination, and experience requirements that are: (i) substantially equivalent to those required by the laws of this State

national_association.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
national_association.quote: "AICPA" means the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

regulatory_model.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice certified public accountancy in the State

credential_type.quote: "License" means, unless the context requires otherwise, a license issued by the Board to practice certified public accountancy

is_mandatory.quote: Except as provided in § 2–321 of this subtitle, an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice certified public accountancy in the State

title_protection.quote: a person may not represent to the public, by use of a title, including "licensed certified public accountant", "certified public accountant", "public accountant", or "auditor", by use of the abbreviation "CPA", by description of services, methods, or procedures, or otherwise, that the person is authorized to practice certified public accountancy in the State

scope_protection.quote: a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice certified public accountancy in the State unless licensed by the Board or qualified for a practice privilege under § 2–321 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively obtaining or attempting to obtain a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraudulently or deceptively obtains or attempts to obtain a license for the applicant or licensee or for another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively using a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraudulently or deceptively uses a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony under federal or state law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: under the laws of the United States or of any state, is convicted of: 1. a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a misdemeanor directly related to fitness and qualification to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is convicted of: 2. a misdemeanor that is directly related to the fitness and qualification of the applicant or licensee to practice certified public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of fraud or other dishonesty in the practice of accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of fraud or other dishonesty in the practice of accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of gross negligence in the practice of accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of gross negligence in the practice of accountancy
violates any provision of Subtitle 6 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Right to practice as CPA in another state denied, revoked, or suspended
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had the right to practice as a certified public accountant in another state denied, revoked, or suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sanctioned in another state in a matter relating to practice of public accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been sanctioned in another state in a matter relating to the practice of public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Renewal of right to practice as CPA in another state denied for cause other than failure to pay renewal fee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had the renewal of the right to practice as a certified public accountant in another state denied for any cause other than failure to pay a renewal fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Right to practice as CPA before any unit of State or federal government revoked or suspended
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had the right to practice as a certified public accountant before any unit of the State or federal government revoked or suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sanctioned by any unit of State or federal government for act or omission directly relating to fitness to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been sanctioned by any unit of State or federal government, or any regulatory entity established by law, for an act or omission that directly relates to the fitness of the applicant or licensee to practice public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of rules of professional conduct adopted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violates a rule of professional conduct adopted by the Board

definition_quote.value: Practice certified public accountancy means to perform any of the following accountancy services: (1) conducting an audit, review, or compilation of financial statements; (2) conducting any examination, review, or agreed–upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements issued by AICPA; or (3) providing a written certificate or opinion offering positive or negative assurance or full or limited assurance on the correctness of the information or on the fairness of the presentation of the information in: (i) a financial statement; (ii) a report; (iii) a schedule; or (iv) an exhibit
definition_quote.quote: "Practice certified public accountancy" means to perform any of the following accountancy services: (1) conducting an audit, review, or compilation of financial statements; (2) conducting any examination, review, or agreed–upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements issued by AICPA; or (3) providing a written certificate or opinion offering positive or negative assurance or full or limited assurance on the correctness of the information or on the fairness of the presentation of the information in: (i) a financial statement; (ii) a report; (iii) a schedule; or (iv) an exhibit

methods_authorized.quote: conducting an audit, review, or compilation of financial statements; conducting any examination, review, or agreed–upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements issued by AICPA

attest_services_types.quote: "Attest" means to provide the following services: (1) an audit or other engagement performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards issued by AICPA; (2) a review of a financial statement performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services issued by AICPA; (3) a compilation; (4) any examination, review, or agreed–upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements issued by AICPA; and (5) any engagement performed in accordance with the Auditing Standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means a presentation of information in the form of a financial statement that is performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services issued by AICPA

education_semester_hours_required.quote: an applicant shall have satisfactorily completed 150 semester hours or their equivalent, including the attainment of a baccalaureate or higher degree that meets the requirements of this section

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: In order to take the examination, an applicant shall have satisfactorily completed 120 semester hours or their equivalent, and hold a baccalaureate or higher degree that meets the requirements of this section

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: An individual who qualifies for a practice privilege under this section may practice certified public accountancy in the State: (i) by any means, including mail, telephone, or electronic communication; and (ii) without any notice, fee, or other submission to the Board

value: personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the Board
complying with State public accountancy laws and regulations adopted by the Board
appointment of the State Board of Public Accountancy as agent for service of process
ceasing to offer or provide services in the State if license in home state is no longer valid
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: As a condition of the practice privilege, an individual who is licensed by another state and qualifies for a practice privilege under this subtitle and any firm that employs the individual to practice in the State shall both consent to: (1) the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the Board; (2) complying with State public accountancy laws and regulations adopted by the Board; (3) the appointment of the State Board of Public Accountancy that issued the individual's license to practice certified public accountancy as the agent upon which process may be served in any action or proceeding by the Board against the individual; and (4) ceasing to offer or provide services in the State that are subject to this title if the license issued by the state in which the individual's principal place of business is located is no longer valid

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: A sole practitioner who is practicing in the State under the practice privilege may only perform attest services as defined in § 2–101(c)(1), (4), or (5) of this title, through a firm that holds a permit issued under § 2–401 of this title

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: have at least a simple majority of the partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, in terms of financial interest and voting rights, be licensed in a state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: An individual who is not licensed to practice certified public accountancy in this State or another state may have an ownership interest in the partnership if: (1) a simple majority of the ownership of the partnership, in terms of financial interests and voting rights, is held by individuals licensed to practice certified public accountancy in this or another state

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: A licensee or permit holder who performs any of the services described in § 2-4A-04 of this subtitle shall be required to undergo, at least once every 3 years, a peer review

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: A licensee or permit holder who performs any of the services described in § 2-4A-04 of this subtitle shall be required to undergo, at least once every 3 years, a peer review

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The Board shall place a licensee on inactive status and issue an inactive status certificate to the licensee, if the licensee: (1) submits to the Board an application for inactive status on the form that the Board provides; (2) pays to the Board an inactive status fee set by the Board; and (3) except for the continuing education requirements set under § 2–312 of this subtitle, qualifies for an active license

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that does not have an office in this State may perform attest services as defined in § 2–101(c) of this title for a client in this State without a permit if the firm: (1) meets the application and peer review requirements under §§ 2–402, 2–402.1, and 2–403 of this subtitle and § 2–4A–02 of this title; and (2) performs services through an individual with a practice privilege under § 2–321 of this title in the state where the individual with a practice privilege retains a principal place of business

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: have a permanent office in the State from which an individual is licensed to practice certified public accountancy

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: Unless the client to whom an accountant's document relates and the accountant expressly agree to the contrary, the accountant's document is: (1) the property of the accountant who prepared it; or (2) if the accountant is a partner or employee of an accounting firm, the property of the firm

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote:
a compilation of a financial statement that:
A.    does not reference the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services issued by AICPA; and
B.    expressly states that the person has not undergone and is not required to undergo peer review

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of a single representation described in paragraph (1) of this subsection is, without evidence of a general course of conduct, adequate to justify a finding that a person has represented to the public that the person is authorized to practice certified public accountancy in the State

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm shall hold a permit issued by the Board if the firm: (1) has an office in this State that performs attest services as defined in § 2–101(c) of this title
